plan.assessment: Check books — this is the week's main evidence of progress.

plan.title: Challenge extension
plan.detail: Early finishers try a harder version, or explain their thinking to a partner still working.
plan.studentActivity: Attempt the challenge version, or teach a partner who is still working.
plan.assessment: Listen in on pupil explanations — a good sign of secure understanding.

plan.title: Reflect and celebrate
plan.detail: Celebrate what the class achieved this week; preview next week's topic in one sentence.
plan.studentActivity: Share one thing they are proud of from this week.
plan.assessment: Quick temperature check (thumbs) on confidence with this week's topic.

lessons.moralDescription: In computing, close enough is often not close enough.
lessons.quote: First, solve the problem. Then, write the code.
lessons.foodForThought: How would today's task go differently without precision?
